entries.name: Missing security headers
entries.description: Checks an authorized HTTP response for missing baseline security headers such as HSTS, CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, and Referrer-Policy.
prerequisites: At least one discovered HTTP route
evidenceExpectations: Response status and security headers for each tested route

entries.name: CORS misconfiguration
entries.description: Reviews CORS response headers for overly broad origins or credential combinations on an authorized route.
prerequisites: A discovered route that returns CORS headers
evidenceExpectations: Request Origin value and CORS response headers

entries.name: Authentication rate limiting
entries.description: Observes a bounded number of authentication attempts to assess whether rate limiting is present. The adapter must enforce a small request budget.
prerequisites: An authentication route discovered from the repository
evidenceExpectations: Attempt count, response status distribution, and Retry-After headers

entries.name: Insecure cookie attributes
entries.description: Inspects Set-Cookie attributes on an authorized route for missing Secure, HttpOnly, and SameSite protections. Cookie values are never recorded.
prerequisites: A discovered route that sets cookies
evidenceExpectations: Cookie names and attribute flags only; values are never recorded

entries.name: Information disclosure
entries.description: Passively inspects an authorized response for version banners, debug headers, directory listings, and stack-trace markers. Response bodies are not retained.
prerequisites: At least one discovered HTTP route
evidenceExpectations: Banner, debug-header, and body-marker identifiers without response bodies

entries.name: TLS baseline configuration
entries.description: Inspects the TLS handshake and certificate metadata for an authorized HTTPS origin without changing target state.
prerequisites: Network access permitted by target authorization
evidenceExpectations: Negotiated protocol, cipher suite, and certificate metadata

entries.name: Potential secret exposure
entries.description: Searches the pinned repository snapshot for high-confidence credential patterns. The adapter must never print the matched secret value.
evidenceExpectations: File path, pattern class, and redacted evidence only

entries.name: Dependencies with known advisories
entries.description: Compares parsed dependency inventory against an approved vulnerability advisory dataset. It does not install or execute dependencies.
prerequisites: A parsed manifest or lockfile inventory
evidenceExpectations: Dependency name, declared version, advisory identifier, and affected range

entries.name: Baseline load profile
entries.description: Runs a conservative baseline load profile against one authorized literal route. The profile must remain within approved rate, duration, and request limits.
prerequisites: A literal GET or HEAD route
evidenceExpectations: Request count, throughput, error rate, and latency percentiles
